facts.content: Patient has central chest pressure rated 7 out of 10.
facts.source_text: CC: central chest pressure (“like someone sitting on chest”) 7/10

facts.content: Onset of chest pressure approximately 2 hours ago while gardening; it is constant.
facts.source_text: onset ~2 h ago while gardening; constant

facts.content: Chest pressure radiates to the left shoulder and arm; no radiation to the head or back.
facts.source_text: Radiation: L shoulder/arm; no head/back radiation

facts.content: Associated symptoms include shortness of breath, light-headedness, and nausea without vomiting.
Baseline exertional dyspnea on stairs and hills with calf pain and leg swelling.
facts.source_text: Baseline: exertional dyspnea on stairs/hills, calf pain & leg swelling

facts.content: Patient has a history of hypertension.
Patient has a history of hypercholesterolemia.
Patient is a smoker and lives with his wife.
Patient's activities of daily living are limited due to dyspnea.
High suspicion of acute coronary syndrome given symptoms and risk factors.
facts.source_text: 1. Chest pain/pressure – high suspicion ACS given central pressure, radiation, SOB, N/V, HTN, HLD, smoking

facts.content: Patient has a tobacco use disorder.
Call 999 for immediate ambulance to emergency department.
In route and in ED: cardiac monitor, ECG, serial troponins, chest X-ray, full labs, oxygen as needed.
facts.source_text: En route/ED: cardiac monitor, ECG, serial troponins, CXR, full labs, O2 PRN

facts.content: Supportive care includes keeping calm, sipping water, and remaining with wife until transport arrives.
facts.source_text: Supportive: keep calm, sip water, remain with wife until transport arrives

facts.content: Post-discharge follow-up planned after hospital evaluation.
